purpose: Per phone, the size its stored Settings hold after the app's own mode picker mapped the shipped default size to the camera's nearest mode. tools/user_launch.py video_state treats a stored size equal to the shipped default (426x240) or to this equivalent (the pair, both dimensions) as the default; any other size still blocks an app_default case (video_setting_not_default). A phone without an entry keeps the strict check.
mechanism: MainActivity mode pickers replace the stored size with the camera's nearest mode and log 'BENCHMARK mode_mapping: requested=426x240 effective=WxH | reason=nearest_camera_mode'; the next persistVideoSettings (for example the bitrate clamp in a person's launch) stores the mapped size (app integration commit 0983c1f2, MainActivity.kt about lines 7252 and 7590-7610).
